description: This is a SvelteKit server-side route module implementing OAuth login flow with Google, including PKCE for security, handling OAuth callback, token exchange with Django backend, and cookie management.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Main server load function that initiates OAuth flow, handles OAuth callback, or redirects authenticated users.

methods.name: handleOAuthCallback
methods.description: Handles OAuth callback, verifies state, exchanges code for tokens via Django backend, and manages cookies.

methods.name: generateOAuthUrl
methods.description: Creates OAuth URL with PKCE parameters, generates state and code verifier, saves them in cookies.

methods.name: getCookieOptions
methods.description: Returns cookie options with secure flag based on environment.
